knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 4.2.6
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. In one sentence each: (1) what deviance measures; (2) why a scale/dispersion idea appears as scaled deviance; (3) how GLM parameters are typically estimated (likelihood language).
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Deviance contrasts fitted vs saturated (likelihood). Scaled deviance accounts for dispersion/scale. Parameters estimated by maximum likelihood (IRLS etc. as CMP).
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 4.2.6
knowledge_checks.prompt: Refuse: 'GLM estimation is just OLS.' What changes?
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Refuse OLS-copy. GLM estimation uses likelihood for the exponential-family response with a link — Normal+identity recovers OLS as special case.
